title: Core Solo #37
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph with a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Korean woman in her early 30s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, fair ivory skin, sharply angled thin brows, a razor-sharp winged cat-eye liner extending far past the outer corner, deep brown-black eyeshadow, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, strongly sculpted contour, a deep wine-red matte lip, long sleek black hair, a cold, commanding gaze, bold and confident, low bun hair, real living eyes. Long stiletto nails, glossy finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman. A full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms. Not thin, not androgynous, not boyish, not a straight figure. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern — a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion, wide silver bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense optical illusion grid filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Pose: leaning against a wall just out of frame.

Footwear: Extreme silver extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Background & Lighting: the painted pattern catching the light in sharp glints, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
